M-COMPUTED-BEHAVIOR.Purpose: Reactive derived Behavior whose Value is lazily computed and memoized from existing Behavior dependencies; invalidation has its own synchronous lifecycle, independent of when Value is read.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: ComputedBehavior<TResult>: dependency references, cache validity, lazy evaluation, invalidation lifecycle, polymorphic state handoff, cloning and semantic equality.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Computed.Select and Group.Combine: typed authoring surfaces for one or multiple dependencies.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Activation, ticking, ownership or reset of dependency instances — delegated to their owners.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Dependency OnUpdate correctness — guaranteed by each concrete dependency Behavior contract.

Requirements.REQ-001: ComputedBehavior<TResult> derives from Behavior<TResult>; no separate value or lifecycle hierarchy is introduced.
Requirements.REQ-002: The supplied computation is pure and reads dependency Value properties; it produces the derived result without side effects.
Requirements.REQ-003: Value computes only when its cache is dirty and is read; successful evaluation caches the result and marks the cache clean. Clean reads reuse the cached result without re-evaluation.
Requirements.REQ-004: Explicit Value assignment is accepted and stored as a clean cached override until the next invalidation; the next computation can replace that assignment.
Requirements.REQ-005: Target is independently assignable passive state: it does not drive computation, trigger execution or provide an implicit fallback for errors.
Requirements.REQ-006: Dependencies are borrowed existing Behavior instances. Computed subscribes to their OnUpdate when activated and unsubscribes when reset, without activating, ticking or resetting them.
Requirements.REQ-007: Activation is idempotent and raises OnActivate only. It discards any cache obtained before activation without emitting an initial OnStart, OnUpdate or OnComplete cycle.
Requirements.REQ-008: While active, a dependency OnUpdate invalidates the cache only on a clean-to-dirty transition and emits one synchronous OnStart, OnUpdate(1f), OnComplete cycle. The transition never eagerly invokes the computation.
Requirements.REQ-009: OnComplete signals the end of invalidation propagation, not the materialization of Value; the cache may remain dirty without a time limit. IsUpdating is true only during the synchronous event cycle, then false; State remains Active.
Requirements.REQ-010: Further dependency events while already dirty produce no additional cycle. If an observer reads Value and a new clean-to-dirty transition occurs during event dispatch, its cycle is queued and delivered after the current OnComplete, never recursively.
Requirements.REQ-011: Update(deltaTime) does not tick or recompute; repeated updates leave cache and lifecycle untouched.
Requirements.REQ-012: UnionWith(source) transfers applicable typed Value/Target information while respecting explicit assignments and leaving the computed cache dirty so the next read derives its own result.
Requirements.REQ-013: SemEquals compares computation delegates and dependency instance identities, plus applicable explicit typed configuration; cached evaluation history alone does not define identity.
Requirements.REQ-014: Clone creates a separate computed instance and independent dirty cache with the same computation and shared dependency instances; Reset releases subscriptions and internal runtime state.
Requirements.REQ-015: Exceptions from the computation remain observable and leave the cache dirty for a later retry. Recursive evaluation of a computed Value is rejected as a cyclic dependency.
Requirements.REQ-016: Select<TIn,TOut>(Behavior<TIn>, Func<TIn,TOut>) creates one ComputedBehavior<TOut>; Group.Combine creates a ComputedBehavior<TResult> from multiple typed dependencies, with an untyped dependency-list overload for arbitrary arity.

Inputs.IN-001: computer: Func<TResult> — pure computation invoked on demand.
Inputs.IN-002: dependencies: borrowed Behavior instances whose OnUpdate invalidates the computed cache.
Inputs.IN-003: source: Behavior — optional previous instance supplied to UnionWith.

Outputs.OUT-001: Value: TResult — cached derived result (or explicit temporary assignment).
Outputs.OUT-002: Target: TResult — passive typed state independent of computation.
Outputs.OUT-003: OnStart, OnUpdate(1f), OnComplete — synchronous invalidation lifecycle events after a clean-to-dirty transition.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Subscribes to dependency OnUpdate while active; detaches subscriptions on Reset.
SideEffects.EFF-002: Notifies its observers of invalidation without computing Value.
